ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral surface, with low-intensity pixels localized to the periphery and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous regions of high-intensity pixels occupy the central interior of both lobes. A continuous band of irregular, high-contrast dark-intensity mottling is mapped along the trailing edges and distal tips. A prominent, isolated dark circular blob is positioned in the mid-lower quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant vertical depth into the fluke anatomy.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels across the trailing edge; serration frequency increases significantly toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex trajectory, while the trailing edges demonstrate a sigmoid curve, transitioning from concave near the medial notch to convex at the outer lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible as dark-toned scratches oriented sub-vertically on the light-toned field of the inner right lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive, isolated dark circular macro-spot on the light-toned field of the left lobe serving as a primary identifier.
